purpose: Third development-informed same-case qualification after R4 exposed network-feedback leakage and project-local import false positives. This run tests V2 constraint precision, fresh-environment loop timing, and infrastructure fail-closed behavior; it is not algorithm-effect evidence.
qualification_checks: The independent run audit is valid and persisted model usage is nonzero.
Attributable network failure terminates as Unknown before another model proposal.
Exact repository-local modules do not become external module constraints.
Any second candidate is proposed only after prior internal V2 evidence and normalized constraints are persisted.
Post-episode official evidence is absent from every model request and online state transition.

reporting.network_retry: Only one separately recorded retry after explicit user confirmation of a local network failure.
